ACT XIX OF 2004
ACT XIX OF 2004
PUNJAB FINANCE
ACT, 2004
An Act to enhance,
reduce and rationalize certain taxes
fees and duties in
the Province of the Punjab
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 30th June, 2004]
No.PAP-Legis-2(14)/2004/638,
dated 30-6-2004.-----The Punjab Finance Bill, 2004, having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 28 June, 2004, and assented to by the
Governor of the Punjab on 30 June, 2004, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:---
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Punjab Finance Act, 2004.
(2) It shall extend to the whole
of the Punjab.
(3) It shall come into force on
the first day of July, 2004.
